checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
from urllib.parse import unquote
paths = [Path("CHANGELOG.md"), Path("docs/development.md"), Path("docs/current-contracts.md"), Path("docs/shared-evaluation-reporting.md"), *Path("specs/028-shared-extraction").glob("*.md")]
for path in paths:
    content = path.read_text()
    assert sum(line.startswith("```") for line in content.splitlines()) % 2 == 0, path
    for target in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)", content):
        if "://" in target or target.startswith("#"):
            continue
        target = unquote(target.split("#", 1)[0])
        assert (path.parent / target).exists(), (path, target)
print(f"Validated Markdown fences and local links in {len(paths)} files")
PY
